A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2932 identities would post 1732 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
